stem.en: Voting from home is for senior citizens above 85 and for Persons with Disabilities with a benchmark disability of 40%. Which of these voters can use it?

text.en: A voter aged 84 who finds the walk hard
A voter with a benchmark disability of 35%
A voter aged 86 with no disability
A voter who lives four hours from a booth

explanation.en: Only the voter aged 86 meets a rule: above 85. Age 84 and a 35% disability both fall short of the numbers, and distance from a booth is not one of the two conditions.

hints.en: Check each voter against the two numbers.
A hard journey is not one of the conditions.
